---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Browse a SeaTable base, its tables and the first 100 rows using a base API token. Cell editing and pagination are unavailable. Tokens are refreshed once on authorization failure.

This page describes the October–November 2026 refinements. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install. Open the existing ios/*.xcodeproj in a full Xcode installation for iOS.

```sh
cd android
./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug bundleRelease
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-table/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-table/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action.

Observed remote verification on 2026-10-31: [commit `58f092bac1d4`](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-table/commit/58f092bac1d4ab2f73c50e4b88f0ea820904b2d4) passed [Android tests, lint, debug APK and unsigned release AAB packaging, plus the full unsigned iOS simulator build](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-table/actions/runs/41200525993). Its [documentation build and deployment](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-table/actions/runs/41200526005) also passed. Device journeys, live-service acceptance where applicable, release signing and store submission remain separate from these results.

The November 2 API 35/4 KiB emulator pass verified missing-token/HTTPS validation, a visible local connection refusal and relaunch without retaining failed credentials. Successful SeaTable base/table workflows still require a disposable live test account.
